# featbit_policy (Data Source)

Reads one custom or built-in FeatBit Policy by exact UUID or organization-scoped case-sensitive exact key.

Configure exactly one selector: `id` for a UUID or `key` for an
organization-scoped, case-sensitive exact key. Key lookup scans the complete
Policy collection and rejects zero or duplicate exact matches. It never
selects the first fuzzy result.

This data source is the supported way to reference built-in Policies such as
`Owner`. Its statements are observations only. A built-in Policy can be a
Group-Policy binding or direct-Policy target, but no provider resource can
change or delete it. Server-managed statement shapes do not expand the
stricter catalog accepted by the custom Policy resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "featbit_policy" "owner" {
  key = "Owner"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Exact Policy UUID. Configure exactly one of `id` or `key`.
- `key` (String) Organization-scoped case-sensitive exact Policy key. Configure exactly one of `id` or `key`.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Policy description, canonicalized to an empty string when absent.
- `name` (String) Policy display name.
- `statements` (Attributes Set) Canonical unordered Policy statements. Built-in statement shapes are observed read-only and do not widen the managed Policy schema. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--statements))
- `type` (String) Policy type: CustomerManaged or SysManaged.

<a id="nestedatt--statements"></a>
### Nested Schema for `statements`

Read-Only:

- `actions` (Set of String) Canonical statement action set.
- `effect` (String) Server-reported statement effect.
- `resource_type` (String) Server-reported statement resource type.
- `resources` (Set of String) Canonical statement resource selector set.
